BARReach.fact: The four CmdBindDescriptorSets callsites found in the active Zink C/C++ sources pass dynamicOffsetCount=0 and nullptr. They cover updated sets, identical-set rebinding across compatibility changes, the non-push fallback, and bindless binding.
BARReach.limit: Static source reach; no fresh call count, CPU sample, timing or BAR trace was collected. Other Vulkan applications/clients may use dynamic offsets.

BARReach.fact: The R/Small graphics path already skips all per-stage implicit-data preparation when the affected descriptor sets use argument buffers and dynamicOffsetCount is zero. The PR must not reintroduce those loops.

Argument-buffer mode is chosen per layout. Push layouts and some device/feature cases can use Off. Apple-family feature initialization enables native texture swizzle, but a global configuration/one source branch alone is not proof that every actual set uses argument buffers.
BARReach.limit: Do not declare all BAR implicit work absent. Off-mode size/swizzle preparation remains possible; the pinned PR itself marks this path changed unconditionally.

BARReach.fact: Three local invalidateMetal4ImplicitBuffer calls independently invalidate native slot revisions. A legacy changedData-only port leaves those calls, native registration and prepared-payload work unchanged.

costJudgment.judgment: This is too limited a proven target to justify introducing layout/meaningful-size comparison state in this bundle. Prioritize the independently accepted 11a proposal after parent selection.
notRemoved: affected-set descriptorSetData clearing and resource-registration freshness
costJudgment.safeRemainingTarget: With affected-set resource-use invalidation and native M4 invalidation retained, the immediate common argument-buffer/no-dynamic candidate mainly avoids legacy implicit-binding tag checks/clears. Graphics helper preparation is already skipped; compute still has a small set/layout walk.
costJudgment.uncertainty: This is a priority judgment from source contracts, not measured zero benefit, a claimed regression, or proof that all duplicate descriptor work has been eliminated.

decision: Do not mechanically import the PR or add new tracking state now. The proposed product patch is deliberately empty; root may accept the hold or reopen a narrower experiment after the active comparison.

futureNarrowDesignIfReopened.dataHandling: Preserve offset consumption order, per-stage skipped offsets and final consumed-count assertion. No global descriptor cache, new resource lifetime sharing, temporary full-array copies or broad versioning of M3 descriptors.
futureNarrowDesignIfReopened.eligibleOptimization: Only legacy implicit dirty marking when actual copied values, effective size and an established layout/packing association are unchanged. Fresh, grown, unknown association or ambiguous partial state remains dirty.
futureNarrowDesignIfReopened.holdRationale: A concrete safe source patch is intentionally not supplied while the useful target is this limited; this document is not approval of an unimplemented general equality memo.
futureNarrowDesignIfReopened.noNewMeasurementProject: Use already available observations or the existing bounded comparison workflow if reopened. Do not create a collector merely to keep this candidate active.
futureNarrowDesignIfReopened.offMode: Leave Off-mode size/swizzle handling conservative unless a separate exact-value design is explicitly selected. The pinned PR does not optimize those copies.
reopenEvidence: An existing BAR observation or profiler identifies meaningful legacy implicit payload rebinding in a reachable path, rather than only a descriptor bind count.
A revised upstream change supplies tested size/packing and mutable-resource safeguards appropriate to this local stack.
Root explicitly elects a bounded low-cost legacy experiment despite uncertain gain; it still requires independent proposal review and a separate implementation grant.

parentIndependence.11a: Engine-only proposal stays separate and byte-identical. No product, fixture, build, raw library, app, profile or pointer is changed here.
parentIndependence.RAndSmall: The relevant bind/helper/invalidation function bodies are identical in exact R and current Small; reserve modifies a separate earlier preparation region. Any future patch must use exact shared contexts and never copy the full Small state file onto R.

requiredSafetyBoundaries.arrayInitialization: If pointer comparison is later introduced, explicitly zero-initialize the descriptor pointer array. That initialization alone has no established performance benefit and is not submitted as a standalone optimization here.
requiredSafetyBoundaries.encoderAndHelpers: First use after a fresh render/compute encoder must bind/register. Preserve graphics/compute stage-switch invalidation and helper-overwritten root/table-slot recovery. Never turn pointer equality into a whole-prepare early return.
requiredSafetyBoundaries.layoutPacking: Unchanged values and vector capacity do not establish unchanged effective payload length or packing. common._layout may already have been replaced by pipeline binding; it is not a previous descriptor-bind association. Any future memo needs an explicit valid previous association, conservative reset/copy/transition rules and meaningful length, or must miss conservatively.
requiredSafetyBoundaries.legalSchedules: Do not use an illegal update of an ordinary bound descriptor set to claim a Vulkan bug. Permitted UAB/unused-while-pending updates, host synchronization and actual encode timing need separate legal schedules.
requiredSafetyBoundaries.pointerEquality: Same descriptor-set pointer is not a contents/revision/incarnation proof. Preserve affected-set clearing in the first narrow port. Current M4 stamps are unavailable or ineligible in M3, foundation-OFF and some mutable cases.
requiredSafetyBoundaries.unchangedScopes: Keep reserve unit1, 11a proposal, allocator policy, pipeline/descriptor lifetime ownership, argument-buffer modes and all existing M4 invalidation unchanged.
requiredSafetyBoundaries.zeroGrowth: Mark new meaningful coverage/length dirty before mvkEnsureSize. Comparing after zero-initialized growth can miss [0,0] to [0,0,0] while Metal still holds a two-word payload.

upstream.scope: Comparison of the pinned change only, not a claim about later PR revisions or its current merge status.
